title: Food Scale, Kitchen Scale, Weight Scale Grams and Ounces for Weight Loss, Baking, Cooking, Keto and Meal Prep, LCD Display, 304 Stainless Steel
description:
About this item
【Food Scale】 Between the design and quality, this kitchen scale is going to last and function at an impeccable level. Your cooking just got ten times easier!
【Multi-units Conversion】This scale can easily converts units between (oz, mL, lb:oz, g), and can help you measure different type of foods and ingredients.
【Gram Scale】All of the qualities you need and expect in a kitchen food scale: readings down to the gram, an eleven pound capacity, and easy to read display. What more could you want?
【Simple And Stylish】Don’t let the kitchen accessories cramp your style—the simplistic, modern design of this scale fits right in with the decor of any trendy space. Go ahead and leave it on the counter, it shows you care about your kitchen.
【Backlit LCD and Easy Clean】The food scale has large backlit LCD display. The food scale is suitable for weight loss, cooking, baking and preparing meals. The food scale is equipped with a stainless steel panel, which is sleek, food residues can be easily wiped.

The item arrived in poor, used, and non-working, condition. Item was shipped in a bag, not a box.
And the item's box inside the bag was damaged in multiple places. The outside of the box has holes in it. And the item looks very handled and doesn't operate properly. There are black smudges on the backside of the item. And dirty, greasy looking fingerprints smeared all over the front. Plus, scratches on the screen. Tested item to see if it works and might be worth just cleaning up, but the item is not functioning properly. It's not worth keeping. The screen keeps scrolling through displaying all kinds of different weights with nothing on the scale. When trying to test weight, the scale provided different and inaccurate results. Furthermore, the item isn't sitting flush on a level surface. Instead, it appears to be tilting more to one end (higher in the front, lower in the back). It appears that I've received a previously returned, damaged, item. And am not happy that I'll need to make a special trip to the post office to return it for a refund. Such a waste of my time. I do NOT recommend this item to others. And please note that the pics don't do the damages justice.Broke in less than a month. The scale I bought from a different company lasted 4 years.
